c4.name: en
c4.transport_retry: 5 initialization attempts; 4 iteration restarts with deterministic skip(emitted); delays 5/10/20/30s; transient transport failures only

dolma3.transport_retry: 5 initialization attempts; 4 iteration restarts with deterministic skip(emitted); delays 5/10/20/30s; transient transport failures only
dolma3.group_sampling: stable round robin: one article per active group; remove groups only upon exhaustion

near_duplicate_definition: normalized 5-word-shingle frequency SimHash Hamming distance <= 3; exact normalized text/URL duplicates also removed
filter_limitation: Deterministic conservative screen plus saved article audit; no claim that a web corpus is provably free of all dialogue.
source_url_limitation: Unavailable or archive-only URLs are recorded. URL disjointness is verified only for usable canonical URLs; normalized-text and SimHash checks also cover URL-unavailable sources.
pilot_subset_rule: same source stream, hash partition and first per-source/per-split accepted representatives
independent_role_assignment: one role per article, balanced per-corpus six-article blocks with deterministic permutations; not all six matched wrappers per article

balanced_assignment.single: per corpus, deterministic permutation per six-article ordinal block; namespace single-role-v1
balanced_assignment.one_round: per corpus, deterministic permutation per five-article ordinal block; namespace single-template-v1
balanced_assignment.rng_seed: first 16 SHA256 hex digits of seed:namespace:source:block; random.Random then shuffle
balanced_assignment.independent_rng: assignment does not consume fragment or multi-round RNG

supervision: article-body tokens only; headers, delimiters, Q JSON and D tool definitions excluded
